08.11.2023

Ms. N. Bordoloi, learned Standing Counsel, Revenue Department has placed on record the copy of the communication dated 02.11.2023 issued by the Additional District Magistrate cum Land Acquisition Officer, Dhubri, as per which, the orders for payment of Zirat compensation to the tune of Rs.14,57,124/- is issued in the name of the appellant herein after deducting TDS as per IT Guidelines vide Letter No. F. No.Misc/ACIT-TDS/GHY/2015-16/2739, dated 27.01.2016.

entities.text: Additional District Magistrate cum Land Acquisition Officer, Dhubri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. I. Haque, learned counsel for the appellant has drawn attention of the Court to Section 96 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, as per which, no income tax or stamp duty shall be levied on any award or agreement made under this Act, except under Section 46 and no person claiming under such award or agreement shall be liable to pay any fee for the copy of the same.
It is not in dispute that the award under question does not fall under Section 46 of the Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Thus, the authorities concerned are required to reconsider the aspect of TDS deducted from the compensation sanctioned in favour of the appellant.
The needful exercise be completed within next 4(four) weeks.
